rows.jyutping: gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for public transit available to ordinary passengers.

example.english: On weekdays, I usually take public transit to work, so I don't have to drive.
example.traditional: 平日返工，我多數搭公共交通工具，唔使自己揸車。
example.jyutping: ping4 jat6 faan1 gung1 ngo5 do1 sou3 daap3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6 m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when sense 1 refers specifically to the vehicles used to carry people or goods.

example.english: This bus is a transit vehicle that carries tourists to the airport.
example.traditional: 呢架巴士係接載遊客去機場嘅交通工具。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 hai6 zip3 zoi3 jau4 haak3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 ge3 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6

rows.note: Use this for the conveyance of people or goods as a process or service, especially freight.

example.english: This company specializes in the transit of goods by sea.
example.traditional: 呢間公司專做海上貨物運輸。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 zou6 hoi2 soeng6 fo3 mat6 wan6 syu1
